title: Hawaiian Stir-Fry Noodles

items: 1 lb fresh stir fry noodles (yakisoba, chow mein, etc)
2-3 Tbsp oil (enough to coat bottom of wok)
¾ head of cabbage, shredded coarsely
2 stalks of green onion, chopped into ½”-1” slices

steps: Preheat wok over the highest heat possible. The oil should instantly start smoking when added to a properly heated wok.
Mix together all sauce ingredients in a small dish and set aside.
It is important to make sure all your ingredients are prepped and ready to go. Steps 3-8 are executed very quickly and delays will result in burnt food.
Add oil the wok, swirling slightly to coat the bottom and sides.
Add the garlic and ginger, stirring quickly to prevent burning.
Immediately add all the remaining vegetables except the green onions, stirring frequently for 1 minute.
Add the noodles, green onion, and sauce, stirring frequently until heated through and well distributed.
sourceNote: Adapted from Trilogy Tours, 2019 Maui Vacation, http://blog.sailtrilogy.com/blog/a-guide-to-trilogys-famous-recipes
